output.claimText: The KAZ_S_159 operator completed mitigation of the 2026-06-05 detected methane plume, and a post-action measurement confirms the outcome by 2026-07-31.
limitations: The pinned UNEP MARS snapshot contains a linked 2026-06-05 observation (7529d451-018f-4da3-9114-59b76c3a3bcd; timestamp 2026-06-05T07:40:02 as displayed; EnMAP - DLR; reported flux 307 ± 66 kg/h) and a later 2026-07-11 observation (941806b5-2afe-46ac-baac-a0230880cede; timestamp 2026-07-11T08:12:14 as displayed; EnMAP - DLR; reported flux 496 ± 226 kg/h). The July observation is in the date window, but no action date or evidence links it as post-action, so timing alone does not establish a post-action measurement or mitigation outcome.

The source-level publisher metadata says notified: Yes and feedback: Yes. It gives no identified notification recipient, exact notification time, action description, or completion date; these flags do not establish notice delivery, repair, or reduced emissions.

The Evidence Library lists one linked publisher report for KAZ_S_159, but its report metadata/body are withheld and it is not included or assessed. Its contents, provenance, and authenticity therefore have not been independently inspected.

The historical snapshot is not continuous monitoring. A later missing observation cannot be read as zero emissions. The snapshot hash identifies the pinned archive but does not authenticate a linked document or establish a physical outcome.

requestedEvidence.item: Attributable action or repair completion record
requestedEvidence.details: Provide the inspectable original or an authoritative source reference for the KAZ_S_159 operator's action associated with observation 7529d451-018f-4da3-9114-59b76c3a3bcd. Identify the operator/site and the specific facility asset or location mapped to that source, the action performed, exact completion date and time in UTC, responsible issuer/signatory, and supporting work-order or field-inspection record.

requestedEvidence.item: Dated post-action measurement and verification record
requestedEvidence.details: Provide a source-linked report for the same mapped site/asset, collected after the documented action and by 2026-07-31 UTC. Include the observation date/time, provider and attributable author, method and instrument, sampling coverage and detection limits, reported methane flux and units, uncertainty, calibration/quality-control information, and the basis for associating the measurement with the 2026-06-05 plume and assessing the action outcome.

Provide an accessible original or authoritative issuer/publisher record, version/date and document provenance sufficient for an independent reviewer to inspect the source and verify its attribution. A declared reference or hash alone is insufficient to establish document authenticity or physical mitigation.

output.whyNeeded: The claim requires both a completed, attributable action and a measurement made after that action within the stated UTC window. The current record contains later satellite data but no action date, post-action linkage, or assessed publisher report, so these requested records are needed to evaluate the sequence, source attribution, measurement limits, and outcome without treating metadata as proof.
acceptanceCriteria: The action record identifies the operator/issuer, KAZ_S_159, the facility asset or location crosswalk, and observation ID 7529d451-018f-4da3-9114-59b76c3a3bcd.
The record describes the action and gives an exact UTC completion timestamp within the assessed period, supported by an attributable work-order, field record, or inspection record.
The verification record is dated after that completion timestamp and no later than 2026-07-31 UTC, and identifies the same source/site/asset and its relation to the specified plume.

The measurement report identifies its provider, timestamp, method/instrument, sampling coverage, detection limits, reported flux units, uncertainty, and calibration or quality-control basis so the result can be evaluated with its limits.

The original or authoritative records and their issuer/provenance are inspectable by a reviewer; a hash, publisher flag, notification, feedback entry, or uninspected link alone does not meet this criterion.
Any resulting conclusion is limited to what the dated measurement supports; it does not claim zero emissions or sustained cessation unless the evidence and method support that bounded conclusion.
